courses.title: Performance Management for HR Leaders
courses.description: Performance Management for HR Leaders takes you from the basics of performance management to applying it on a realistic HR Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to compensation and benefits, enough to use it alongside performance management day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying performance management to a real HR Manager scenario
Practicing performance management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to compensation and benefits
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Diversity and Inclusion Practices
courses.description: Applying Diversity and Inclusion Practices is a focused course on diversity and inclusion practices for people already working toward a HR Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying diversity and inclusion practices on your own.

courses.title: Getting Started with HR Analytics
courses.description: Getting Started with HR Analytics walks you through the basics of hr analytics, built for people new to HR Manager work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of hr analytics, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
